method: Rounded proposed lat/lng -> XYZ z16 extent4096. Decode saved PBF with y down; union point-containing BldA plus explicitly inherited same-building tile fragments; overlapping unselected geometries are listed separately and excluded from nearest non-overlapping footprint; minimum Euclidean boundary/geometry distance times 2*pi*6378137*cos(latitude)/(2^16*4096). RdCL is centerline, not road edge. Other footprints include unnamed roofs/annexes, not necessarily different facilities. No accuracy radius inferred.
licence: 国土地理院最適化ベクトルタイルを加工、PDL1.0。既存2026-07-01版取得記録継承。
limitations: Geometry distances measure separation in this product, not absolute geodetic accuracy.
Selected geometry may represent roof/connected pieces; use identified parts in source comparisons. Never expand to all overlapping neighbors.
Adjacent 3x3 saved tiles and geometries with bounds intersecting +/-2000 tile units around point only; missing tiles explicitly listed.
No rereading of municipal originals or new building-identity approval.
Invalid source geometries are excluded from distance calculations; distances describe valid recorded geometries only.

selectedPortion.limitation: Selected south projection, not surveyed boundary of the entire south wing.
